name: subnet
description: Peer-to-peer LAN chat desktop app inspired by AirDrop

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test: NODE_ENV=test npm run build:electron && NODE_ENV=test node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist-electron/network/__tests__/*.test.js dist-electron/store/__tests__/*.test.js
scripts.package:mac:test: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npx --yes electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --mac dmg --universal --publish never
